condition_description: Lead status at the decision is INVALID, or the prospect is outside the 1-499 employee bands, outside Canada, in excluded sector 91, or already has a relationship.
outcome_meaning: The lead will not be worked and must not receive a priority score.

condition_description: Lead status at the decision is MERGED, or the lead carries a surviving_lead_id.
outcome_meaning: The lead was merged into a survivor; priority belongs to the survivor.

condition_description: Lead status at the decision is WITHDRAWN.
outcome_meaning: The prospect withdrew interest or consent.

condition_description: Lead status at the decision is CONVERTED or CLOSED_LOST.
outcome_meaning: The lead reached a terminal outcome before this decision point.
next_action: No action unless an audited reopening applies

condition_description: Lead status at the decision is DUPLICATE_REVIEW, or an unresolved duplicate group contains the lead at the decision instant.
outcome_meaning: An unresolved duplicate must never be scored or routed.

condition_description: Lead status at the decision is VALIDATION_PENDING.
outcome_meaning: Required data is missing or invalid; the record cannot be worked.

condition_description: Geography status is conflict or missing, or the lead has no resolved territory.
outcome_meaning: Geography cannot be resolved automatically; a person must decide.
next_action: Resolve geography in the manual-review queue

condition_description: Lead status at the decision is NEW, or an initial routing decision is taken while the lead is not READY_FOR_ASSIGNMENT.
outcome_meaning: The lead has not yet reached a routable state at this decision instant.

condition_description: No rule above applies: the lead is valid, unique, in scope, has a resolved territory, and is either READY_FOR_ASSIGNMENT or in active work for a reassignment, override or queue-release decision.
outcome_meaning: The lead receives a recommended priority score and band.
